verdict.rationale: The QuickBooks Workforce API covers viewing employees, deductions, payslips and pensions, plus webhooks that fire after a company runs payroll, but nothing documents an API call that previews or calculates a pending payroll run. The in-product Payroll AI that spots time-data inconsistencies and the UI step to review and approve auto payroll are adjacent features, not an API-driven preview an agent could run. These are building blocks at most and earn no credit.
